reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Consistency is the one most people struggle with, so you're not alone in that. The fix is usually boring: pick a fixed number of days you can actually keep through a bad week, put them in your calendar like appointments, and aim to make the minimum session happen even on rough days. Missing one session is nothing. Missing two in a row is where habits start to slip. Tell me your schedule and what you're training for, and we'll build something you can stick to."}
